
	<h1 class="postTitle"><a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiaozhuang/p/19520445" title="发布于 2026-01-23 09:27">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">AI时代的领域驱动设计：DAD</span>
    

</a>
</h1>
	<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<blockquote data-start="201" data-end="273">
<p data-start="255" data-end="297">在 AI 开始直接参与系统交互之后，传统领域驱动设计（DDD）暴露出一个根本性局限：</p>
<blockquote data-start="299" data-end="328">
<p data-start="301" data-end="328"><strong data-start="301" data-end="328">系统长期只理解“结构”，却不真正理解“意图”。</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="330" data-end="418">无论是方法调用、DTO、RPC 还是事件消息，本质上都是<strong data-start="358" data-end="367">结构化协议</strong>。<br data-start="368" data-end="371">
而在真实世界中，尤其是 AI 参与的场景里，交互首先出现的是<strong data-start="401" data-end="409">语义意图</strong>，而不是稳定结构。</p>
<p data-start="420" data-end="490"><strong data-start="420" data-end="448">DAD（Domain Actor Design）</strong>，是一种面向 AI 时代的领域建模方式，其核心系统单元是 <strong data-start="477" data-end="489">AI Actor</strong>。</p>
<hr data-start="492" data-end="495">
<h2 data-start="497" data-end="524">一、Actor 模型：不是并发技巧，而是领域单元</h2>
<p data-start="526" data-end="539">Actor 模型的本质是：</p>
<ul data-start="541" data-end="627">
<li data-start="541" data-end="561">
<p data-start="543" data-end="561">Actor 是<strong data-start="550" data-end="561">独立运行的实体</strong></p>


</li>
<li data-start="562" data-end="583">
<p data-start="564" data-end="583">Actor 之间<strong data-start="572" data-end="583">只通过消息交互</strong></p>


</li>
<li data-start="584" data-end="605">
<p data-start="586" data-end="605">Actor 内部状态不可被外部直接访问</p>


</li>
<li data-start="606" data-end="627">
<p data-start="608" data-end="627">Actor 自行决定如何处理收到的消息</p>


</li>


</ul>
<p data-start="629" data-end="644">Actor 模型真正解决的是：</p>
<blockquote data-start="646" data-end="681">
<p data-start="648" data-end="681"><strong data-start="648" data-end="681">如何在不共享状态、不直接调用的前提下，让复杂系统保持自治。</strong></p>


</blockquote>
<p data-start="683" data-end="722">在 DAD 中，Actor 不再只是并发模型，而是<strong data-start="708" data-end="721">领域的最小自治单元</strong>。</p>
<hr data-start="724" data-end="727">
<h2 data-start="729" data-end="750">二、传统 DDD 消息化后的真实问题</h2>
<p data-start="752" data-end="767">即便系统已经采用“消息驱动”：</p>
<ul data-start="769" data-end="813">
<li data-start="769" data-end="780">
<p data-start="771" data-end="780">消息依然是固定结构</p>


</li>
<li data-start="781" data-end="794">
<p data-start="783" data-end="794">接收方必须提前知道结构</p>


</li>
<li data-start="795" data-end="813">
<p data-start="797" data-end="813">发送方必须知道对方能处理什么结构</p>


</li>


</ul>
<p data-start="815" data-end="819">结果是：</p>
<blockquote data-start="821" data-end="850">
<p data-start="823" data-end="850"><strong data-start="823" data-end="850">领域之间的耦合，从方法签名，转移成了消息结构。</strong></p>


</blockquote>
<p data-start="852" data-end="871">在 AI 时代，这种问题被进一步放大：</p>
<ul data-start="873" data-end="928">
<li data-start="873" data-end="888">
<p data-start="875" data-end="888">AI 产生的输入天然不稳定</p>


</li>
<li data-start="889" data-end="904">
<p data-start="891" data-end="904">表达可能正确，但结构不完整</p>


</li>
<li data-start="905" data-end="928">
<p data-start="907" data-end="928">系统无法容忍“语义正确但结构不完美”的请求</p>


</li>


</ul>
<hr data-start="930" data-end="933">
<h2 data-start="935" data-end="958">三、DAD 的核心单元：AI Actor</h2>
<p data-start="960" data-end="992">在 DAD 中，<strong data-start="968" data-end="991">领域的最小自治单元是 AI Actor</strong>。</p>
<h3 data-start="994" data-end="1015">AI Actor 由三个部分组成：</h3>
<blockquote data-start="1017" data-end="1047">
<p data-start="1019" data-end="1047"><strong data-start="1019" data-end="1047">Agent + Mailbox + 领域服务程序</strong></p>


</blockquote>
<p data-start="1049" data-end="1070">这是一个<strong data-start="1053" data-end="1066">职责清晰、边界严格</strong>的结构。</p>
<hr data-start="1072" data-end="1075">
<h2 data-start="1077" data-end="1104">四、AI Actor 的三个组成部分（最终定义）</h2>
<h3 data-start="1106" data-end="1134">1️⃣ Agent：AI Actor 的唯一边界</h3>
<p data-start="1136" data-end="1167"><strong data-start="1136" data-end="1167">Agent 才是 AI Actor 的物理与逻辑边界。</strong></p>
<p data-start="1169" data-end="1200">所有进入 Actor 的信息，<strong data-start="1184" data-end="1199">必须先经过 Agent</strong>。</p>
<p data-start="1202" data-end="1213">Agent 的职责是：</p>
<h4 data-start="1215" data-end="1236">（1）语义解析与校验（入口关卡）</h4>
<ul data-start="1238" data-end="1315">
<li data-start="1238" data-end="1262">
<p data-start="1240" data-end="1262">接收外部消息（JSON / 文本 / 混合）</p>


</li>
<li data-start="1263" data-end="1315">
<p data-start="1265" data-end="1268">判断：</p>
<ul data-start="1271" data-end="1315">
<li data-start="1271" data-end="1279">
<p data-start="1273" data-end="1279">对方想做什么</p>


</li>
<li data-start="1282" data-end="1292">
<p data-start="1284" data-end="1292">信息是否语义完整</p>


</li>
<li data-start="1295" data-end="1315">
<p data-start="1297" data-end="1315">是否属于当前 Actor 的职责范围</p>


</li>


</ul>


</li>


</ul>
<p data-start="1317" data-end="1326">❌ 不合格的消息：</p>
<ul data-start="1328" data-end="1370">
<li data-start="1328" data-end="1339">
<p data-start="1330" data-end="1339">直接返回语义化错误</p>


</li>
<li data-start="1340" data-end="1353">
<p data-start="1342" data-end="1353">告知问题在哪里、缺什么</p>


</li>
<li data-start="1354" data-end="1370">
<p data-start="1356" data-end="1370"><strong data-start="1356" data-end="1370">不会进入领域执行路径</strong></p>


</li>


</ul>
<blockquote data-start="1372" data-end="1389">
<p data-start="1374" data-end="1389"><strong data-start="1374" data-end="1389">结构正确 ≠ 语义合法</strong></p>


</blockquote>
<hr data-start="1391" data-end="1394">
<h4 data-start="1396" data-end="1414">（2）意图 → 结构化任务</h4>
<p data-start="1416" data-end="1432">当语义被确认后，Agent 会：</p>
<ul data-start="1434" data-end="1490">
<li data-start="1434" data-end="1453">
<p data-start="1436" data-end="1453">将“意图”转换为<strong data-start="1444" data-end="1453">结构化任务</strong></p>


</li>
<li data-start="1454" data-end="1490">
<p data-start="1456" data-end="1459">明确：</p>
<ul data-start="1462" data-end="1490">
<li data-start="1462" data-end="1468">
<p data-start="1464" data-end="1468">任务类型</p>


</li>
<li data-start="1471" data-end="1479">
<p data-start="1473" data-end="1479">已确认的数据</p>


</li>
<li data-start="1482" data-end="1490">
<p data-start="1484" data-end="1490">执行前置条件</p>


</li>


</ul>


</li>


</ul>
<p data-start="1492" data-end="1514">Agent <strong data-start="1498" data-end="1509">不决定如何执行</strong>，只负责：</p>
<blockquote data-start="1516" data-end="1540">
<p data-start="1518" data-end="1540"><strong data-start="1518" data-end="1540">把“我理解了”变成“你可以执行了”。</strong></p>


</blockquote>
<hr data-start="1542" data-end="1545">
<h4 data-start="1547" data-end="1569">（3）执行结果的语义化输出（出口）</h4>
<p data-start="1571" data-end="1583">领域服务程序执行完成后：</p>
<ul data-start="1585" data-end="1650">
<li data-start="1585" data-end="1602">
<p data-start="1587" data-end="1602">返回的是<strong data-start="1591" data-end="1602">结构化执行结果</strong></p>


</li>
<li data-start="1603" data-end="1650">
<p data-start="1605" data-end="1614">Agent 负责：</p>
<ul data-start="1617" data-end="1650">
<li data-start="1617" data-end="1625">
<p data-start="1619" data-end="1625">解释执行结果</p>


</li>
<li data-start="1628" data-end="1636">
<p data-start="1630" data-end="1636">组织语义响应</p>


</li>
<li data-start="1639" data-end="1650">
<p data-start="1641" data-end="1650">返回给原消息发送方</p>


</li>


</ul>


</li>


</ul>
<blockquote data-start="1652" data-end="1683">
<p data-start="1654" data-end="1683"><strong data-start="1654" data-end="1683">Agent 是唯一的语义入口，也是唯一的语义出口。</strong></p>


</blockquote>
<hr data-start="1685" data-end="1688">
<h3 data-start="1690" data-end="1718">2️⃣ Mailbox：领域服务的任务串行化机制</h3>
<p data-start="1720" data-end="1757">Mailbox <strong data-start="1728" data-end="1747">不是 AI Actor 的边界</strong>，也不承担语义职责。</p>
<p data-start="1759" data-end="1773">Mailbox 的唯一目的：</p>
<blockquote data-start="1775" data-end="1798">
<p data-start="1777" data-end="1798"><strong data-start="1777" data-end="1798">保证领域服务任务的顺序性与一致性。</strong></p>


</blockquote>
<p data-start="1800" data-end="1806">它的特点是：</p>
<ul data-start="1808" data-end="1853">
<li data-start="1808" data-end="1814">
<p data-start="1810" data-end="1814">FIFO</p>


</li>
<li data-start="1815" data-end="1821">
<p data-start="1817" data-end="1821">可持久化</p>


</li>
<li data-start="1822" data-end="1831">
<p data-start="1824" data-end="1831">只存结构化任务</p>


</li>
<li data-start="1832" data-end="1841">
<p data-start="1834" data-end="1841">不理解任务含义</p>


</li>
<li data-start="1842" data-end="1853">
<p data-start="1844" data-end="1853">不参与任何业务决策</p>


</li>


</ul>
<p data-start="1855" data-end="1870">Mailbox 的存在意味着：</p>
<ul data-start="1872" data-end="1936">
<li data-start="1872" data-end="1896">
<p data-start="1874" data-end="1896">领域服务程序只面对<strong data-start="1883" data-end="1896">确定、可执行的任务</strong></p>


</li>
<li data-start="1897" data-end="1916">
<p data-start="1899" data-end="1916">Actor 内部状态不会被并发破坏</p>


</li>
<li data-start="1917" data-end="1936">
<p data-start="1919" data-end="1936">Actor 可以安全重启并恢复执行</p>


</li>


</ul>
<hr data-start="1938" data-end="1941">
<h3 data-start="1943" data-end="1968">3️⃣ 领域服务程序：Actor 的执行体</h3>
<p data-start="1970" data-end="1978">领域服务程序是：</p>
<blockquote data-start="1980" data-end="2017">
<p data-start="1982" data-end="2017"><strong data-start="1982" data-end="2017">一个持续运行、由 Mailbox 驱动的 Actor 执行体。</strong></p>


</blockquote>
<p data-start="2019" data-end="2025">它内部包含：</p>
<ul data-start="2027" data-end="2070">
<li data-start="2027" data-end="2033">
<p data-start="2029" data-end="2033">执行循环</p>


</li>
<li data-start="2034" data-end="2039">
<p data-start="2036" data-end="2039">状态机</p>


</li>
<li data-start="2040" data-end="2048">
<p data-start="2042" data-end="2048">领域对象代码</p>


</li>
<li data-start="2049" data-end="2055">
<p data-start="2051" data-end="2055">业务规则</p>


</li>
<li data-start="2056" data-end="2070">
<p data-start="2058" data-end="2070">状态 / 事件持久化逻辑</p>


</li>


</ul>
<p data-start="2072" data-end="2086">领域服务程序的特征非常明确：</p>
<ul data-start="2088" data-end="2132">
<li data-start="2088" data-end="2098">
<p data-start="2090" data-end="2098">只接收结构化任务</p>


</li>
<li data-start="2099" data-end="2105">
<p data-start="2101" data-end="2105">串行执行</p>


</li>
<li data-start="2106" data-end="2113">
<p data-start="2108" data-end="2113">不解析语义</p>


</li>
<li data-start="2114" data-end="2121">
<p data-start="2116" data-end="2121">不暴露方法</p>


</li>
<li data-start="2122" data-end="2132">
<p data-start="2124" data-end="2132">不直接与外部通信</p>


</li>


</ul>
<blockquote data-start="2134" data-end="2160">
<p data-start="2136" data-end="2160"><strong data-start="2136" data-end="2160">领域对象代码全部存在于领域服务程序内部。</strong></p>


</blockquote>
<hr data-start="2162" data-end="2165">
<h2 data-start="2167" data-end="2196">五、AI Actor 的完整消息处理流程（最终闭环）</h2>
<p data-start="2198" data-end="2230">这是 <strong data-start="2201" data-end="2229">完整且不可省略的 AI Actor 消息生命周期</strong>。</p>
<hr data-start="2232" data-end="2235">
<h3 data-start="2237" data-end="2265">① 外部消息到达 Agent（Actor 边界）</h3>
<ul data-start="2267" data-end="2302">
<li data-start="2267" data-end="2279">
<p data-start="2269" data-end="2279">来自用户 Actor</p>


</li>
<li data-start="2280" data-end="2294">
<p data-start="2282" data-end="2294">来自其他领域 Actor</p>


</li>
<li data-start="2295" data-end="2302">
<p data-start="2297" data-end="2302">或外部系统</p>


</li>


</ul>
<hr data-start="2304" data-end="2307">
<h3 data-start="2309" data-end="2330">② Agent 进行语义解析与校验</h3>
<p data-start="2332" data-end="2341">Agent 判断：</p>
<ul data-start="2343" data-end="2380">
<li data-start="2343" data-end="2351">
<p data-start="2345" data-end="2351">意图是否明确</p>


</li>
<li data-start="2352" data-end="2362">
<p data-start="2354" data-end="2362">数据是否语义完整</p>


</li>
<li data-start="2363" data-end="2380">
<p data-start="2365" data-end="2380">是否在 Actor 职责范围内</p>


</li>


</ul>
<p data-start="2382" data-end="2413">❌ 不合格 → 立即语义反馈<br data-start="2396" data-end="2399">
✅ 合格 → 生成结构化任务</p>
<hr data-start="2415" data-end="2418">
<h3 data-start="2420" data-end="2444">③ 结构化任务进入 Mailbox 排队</h3>
<p data-start="2446" data-end="2462">此时进入 Mailbox 的是：</p>
<blockquote data-start="2464" data-end="2486">
<p data-start="2466" data-end="2486"><strong data-start="2466" data-end="2486">已被理解、已被确认、可执行的任务</strong></p>


</blockquote>
<hr data-start="2488" data-end="2491">
<h3 data-start="2493" data-end="2518">④ 领域服务程序从 Mailbox 取任务</h3>
<ul data-start="2520" data-end="2545">
<li data-start="2520" data-end="2526">
<p data-start="2522" data-end="2526">顺序取出</p>


</li>
<li data-start="2527" data-end="2535">
<p data-start="2529" data-end="2535">加载当前状态</p>


</li>
<li data-start="2536" data-end="2545">
<p data-start="2538" data-end="2545">进入状态机执行</p>


</li>


</ul>
<hr data-start="2547" data-end="2550">
<h3 data-start="2552" data-end="2568">⑤ 领域对象代码执行任务</h3>
<ul data-start="2570" data-end="2601">
<li data-start="2570" data-end="2578">
<p data-start="2572" data-end="2578">执行业务规则</p>


</li>
<li data-start="2579" data-end="2585">
<p data-start="2581" data-end="2585">推进状态</p>


</li>
<li data-start="2586" data-end="2601">
<p data-start="2588" data-end="2601">产生状态变化 / 领域事件</p>


</li>


</ul>
<hr data-start="2603" data-end="2606">
<h3 data-start="2608" data-end="2624">⑥ 状态 / 事件持久化</h3>
<ul data-start="2626" data-end="2650">
<li data-start="2626" data-end="2632">
<p data-start="2628" data-end="2632">记录任务</p>


</li>
<li data-start="2633" data-end="2641">
<p data-start="2635" data-end="2641">记录执行结果</p>


</li>
<li data-start="2642" data-end="2650">
<p data-start="2644" data-end="2650">记录状态演进</p>


</li>


</ul>
<hr data-start="2652" data-end="2655">
<h3 data-start="2657" data-end="2685">⑦ 领域服务程序返回结构化执行结果给 Agent</h3>
<p data-start="2687" data-end="2691">结果是：</p>
<ul data-start="2693" data-end="2717">
<li data-start="2693" data-end="2700">
<p data-start="2695" data-end="2700">无语义包装</p>


</li>
<li data-start="2701" data-end="2708">
<p data-start="2703" data-end="2708">无协议假设</p>


</li>
<li data-start="2709" data-end="2717">
<p data-start="2711" data-end="2717">完全确定性的</p>


</li>


</ul>
<hr data-start="2719" data-end="2722">
<h3 data-start="2724" data-end="2750">⑧ Agent 将结果转为语义消息并返回对方</h3>
<ul data-start="2752" data-end="2782">
<li data-start="2752" data-end="2761">
<p data-start="2754" data-end="2761">解释发生了什么</p>


</li>
<li data-start="2762" data-end="2770">
<p data-start="2764" data-end="2770">描述当前状态</p>


</li>
<li data-start="2771" data-end="2782">
<p data-start="2773" data-end="2782">告知后续可执行意图</p>


</li>


</ul>
<hr data-start="2784" data-end="2787">
<h2 data-start="2789" data-end="2812">六、DAD 相比传统 DDD 的本质变化</h2>
<div class="TyagGW_tableContainer">
<div class="group TyagGW_tableWrapper flex flex-col-reverse w-fit">
<table class="w-fit min-w-(--thread-content-width)" style="height: 250px; width: 721px" data-start="2814" data-end="2950">
<thead data-start="2814" data-end="2830">
<tr data-start="2814" data-end="2830"><th data-start="2814" data-end="2823" data-col-size="sm">传统 DDD</th><th data-start="2823" data-end="2830" data-col-size="sm">DAD</th></tr>

</thead>
<tbody data-start="2845" data-end="2950">
<tr data-start="2845" data-end="2860">
<td data-start="2845" data-end="2852" data-col-size="sm">方法调用</td>
<td data-start="2852" data-end="2860" data-col-size="sm">语义消息</td>

</tr>
<tr data-start="2861" data-end="2878">
<td data-start="2861" data-end="2870" data-col-size="sm">DTO 契约</td>
<td data-col-size="sm" data-start="2870" data-end="2878">意图驱动</td>

</tr>
<tr data-start="2879" data-end="2897">
<td data-start="2879" data-end="2885" data-col-size="sm">聚合根</td>
<td data-col-size="sm" data-start="2885" data-end="2897">AI Actor</td>

</tr>
<tr data-start="2898" data-end="2918">
<td data-start="2898" data-end="2906" data-col-size="sm">应用层编排</td>
<td data-col-size="sm" data-start="2906" data-end="2918">Actor 自治</td>

</tr>
<tr data-start="2919" data-end="2934">
<td data-start="2919" data-end="2926" data-col-size="sm">状态快照</td>

</div>

</div>
<hr data-start="2952" data-end="2955">
<h2 data-start="2957" data-end="2964">七、总结</h2>
<blockquote data-start="2966" data-end="3023">
<p data-start="2968" data-end="3023"><strong data-start="2968" data-end="3023">DAD 不是给 DDD 加 AI，<br data-start="2987" data-end="2990">
而是承认：在 AI 时代，系统必须先“理解”，再“执行”。</strong></p>


</blockquote>
<p data-start="3025" data-end="3048">AI Actor 用清晰的三段结构保证这一点：</p>
<ul data-start="3050" data-end="3126">
<li data-start="3050" data-end="3076">
<p data-start="3052" data-end="3076"><strong data-start="3052" data-end="3061">Agent</strong>：唯一边界，负责理解与表达</p>


</li>
<li data-start="3077" data-end="3104">
<p data-start="3079" data-end="3104"><strong data-start="3079" data-end="3090">Mailbox</strong>：串行化机制，保障一致性</p>


</li>
<li data-start="3105" data-end="3126">
<p data-start="3107" data-end="3126"><strong data-start="3107" data-end="3117">领域服务程序</strong>：确定性执行体</p>


</li>


</ul>
<p data-start="3128" data-end="3160"><strong data-start="3128" data-end="3160">没有直接调用，没有结构耦合，只有被理解后的意图驱动执行。</strong></p>
<p data-start="3162" data-end="3188">这，才是 <strong data-start="3167" data-end="3187">AI 时代的领域驱动设计：DAD</strong>。</p>
</blockquote>
</div>
